question: In which sport did Praveen Kumar Sobti won medals at the Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Discus throw**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Praveen Kumar Sobti**, an Indian athlete, was renowned for his achievements in the **Discus throw** event. 
• He represented **India** in various international competitions, including the **Asian Games**. 
• Praveen Kumar Sobti won **two medals** in the Asian Games in the **Discus throw** category: 
• A **gold medal** at the **1966 Asian Games** held in Bangkok. 
• A **silver medal** at the **1970 Asian Games** held in Bangkok. 
• In addition to his success in the Asian Games, he also represented India in the **Olympics** in 1968 and 1972. 
• Praveen Kumar was not only an athlete but later became famous as an actor, particularly for his role as **Bheem** in the Indian television series **Mahabharat**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Discus Throw:** 
• The **Discus throw** is a track and field event where an athlete throws a heavy disc called a **discus** to achieve the longest distance possible. 
• The sport has its roots in ancient Greece and was part of the original **Olympic Games**. 
• Athletes require a combination of **strength, technique, and agility** to excel in this sport. 
• The discus used in competitions typically weighs **2 kilograms** for men and **1 kilogram** for women. 
• **Asian Games:** 
• The **Asian Games**, also known as the **Asiad**, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia. 
• The first Asian Games were held in **1951** in **New Delhi, India**. 
• India has a strong history of participation in the Asian Games, winning medals in various sports such as athletics, wrestling, shooting, and hockey. 
• **Praveen Kumar Sobti’s Career:** 
• Born on **6 December 1947** in Punjab, India. 
• He joined the **Border Security Force (BSF)** at the age of 20 and pursued athletics while serving the nation. 
• Besides his medals in the Asian Games, he also secured **four medals** at the Commonwealth Games. 
• After retiring from sports, Praveen Kumar Sobti transitioned to **acting** and politics. 
• **Other Sports Options:** 
• **Long Jump:** Involves jumping as far as possible from a take-off point. Not related to Praveen Kumar Sobti. 
• **Shooting:** A sport involving precision and aiming skills. Praveen Kumar was not associated with this sport. 
• **Wrestling:** A combat sport involving grappling techniques. While India has a strong wrestling tradition, Praveen Kumar’s achievements were in discus throw.
